# trustno.si

> A domain name for sale. It reads two ways: "trustno.si" and "Trust No .SI".

## What this is

trustno.si is a single domain name, currently for sale. There is no product,
service or company behind it. The site at https://trustno.si/ is a one-page
listing for the name itself.

The name's second reading comes from the .si TLD being read as "Super
Intelligence" rather than as Slovenia's country code. "Trust No .SI" suits
products in AI/SI safety, security, verification, auditing or provenance.

## Status

- For sale.
- Price: $1,490 USD Buy Now, as listed on both marketplaces linked below.
- No traffic, revenue or valuation claims are made about this domain.
